correction: ChairLift believed a nil error from updex Client.Features meant updex features were configured, so updex.IsInstalled returned true on a host without feature definitions and the Features page showed an empty group with an active Update button. updex returns an empty slice with a nil error when no features are configured; IsInstalled now also requires len(features) > 0.
evidence: github.com/frostyard/updex/v2@v2.1.3 updex/features.go Client.Features ('if len(features) == 0 { ... return []FeatureInfo{}, nil }'); internal/updex.TestUpdexAvailabilityRequiresNonEmptyFeatures; ported from the bluefin chairlift fork (0f069c8e)
